name: Rough Night at Home
storyline:
For generations, the Sagespark family made a dark pact with a demon sacrificing one of their own every 20 years in exchange for unimaginable wealth, luck, and power. But the price was far greater than they ever imagined.

The curse won't end until the entire bloodline is wiped out.

Jacob, the last surviving Sagespark, is determined to break the sinister cycle and end the family’s deadly legacy once and for all. But can he escape the fate that’s claimed so many before him?
summary:
Rough Night at Home is a psychological First-Person horror game where you play as 25-year-old Jacob Sagespark.
For generations, the Sagespark family made a dark pact with a demon sacrificing one of their own every 20 years in exchange for unimaginable wealth, luck, and power. But the price was far greater than they ever imagined.

The curse won't end until the entire bloodline is wiped out.

Jacob, the last surviving Sagespark, is determined to break the sinister cycle and end the family’s deadly legacy once and for all. But can he escape the fate that’s claimed so many before him?

This First-Person game blends immersive storytelling, challenging puzzles, and nostalgic mechanics for a unique thrilling experience. Your ultimate goal is to break a long-standing family curse, with the story and solutions unfolding as you explore and uncover secrets throughout the gameplay.
